content: sam_hdr_read (45 lines): reads the binary BAM header (magic, l_text, text, n_ref, ref entries) from a BGZF stream. sam_hdr_write (75 lines): writes the same. The BAM header binary format is simple and well-documented. Depends on pure Rust BGZF (#65) for the actual byte-level I/O.
